name: Red Wool Bandana
summary: Red Wool Bandanas are makeshift symbols fashioned by imprisoned Defias cutthroats inside the Stormwind Stockade. Torn from jailhouse wool blankets, they serve as defiant emblems of brotherhood even behind bars.

sections.title: Stitched in Defiance
sections.body: Even locked deep within the high stone walls of the Stormwind Stockade, members of the Defias Brotherhood refuse to surrender their identity. Using scraps torn from prison wool blankets, inmates secretly craft red bandanas to wear as identifying colors. To the guards, these scarves are contraband that spark fatal mutinies; to the prisoners, they are a statement that their brotherhood and rebellion endure, even in chains.

sections.title: A Grandmother's Vengeance
sections.body: The bandanas gained a bitter notoriety after fourteen-year-old prison guard Mac Raskol caught inmates shredding blankets to make them. When he attempted to discipline the prisoners, the Defias convicts stabbed him in the back. In the wake of his death, his grieving grandmother Nikova seeks out adventurers to venture into the rioting dungeon, cull the rioters, and retrieve the crimson cloth as proof of vengeance.

faq.q: Where do prisoners get these bandanas in the Stockade?
aliases: how do they make red bandanas
faq.answer: Defias inmates make them by tearing apart their prison-issue wool blankets. Despite being disarmed and imprisoned, they turn their meager bedding into symbols of defiance to wear inside the cells.

Nikova Raskol, a grieving grandmother in Stormwind, asks adventurers to collect them. Her fourteen-year-old grandson Mac was a Stockade guard murdered by prisoners after he caught them making the bandanas.

faq.q: Why do the prisoners care so much about wearing red scarves?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood wears red masks and bandanas as their primary gang colors and uniform. Behind bars, crafting and wearing these scraps lets the inmates maintain their rank, morale, and unity.
They are carried by almost any rioting Defias member in the Stockade, including Defias Captives, Inmates, Prisoners, Insurgents, and Convicts.

angles.text: For Alliance defenders, reclaiming these bandanas is a grim act of justice for young Mac Raskol and a strike against the rioters holding the city's prison.
These rough-hewn bandanas illustrate how even coarse wool blankets can be unraveled and repurposed by desperate hands in captivity.
